episodes.title: Now Is Not the End
episodes.summary: In the premiere episode, "Pilot," when old acquaintance Howard Stark finds himself being framed for unleashing his deadliest weapons to anyone willing to pony up the cash, he contacts Peggy -- the only person he can trust -- to track down those responsible, dispose of the weapons and clear his name. He empowers his butler, Edwin Jarvis, to be at her beck and call when needed to help assist her as she investigates and tracks down those responsible for selling these weapons of mass destruction. If caught going on these secret missions for Stark, Peggy could be targeted as a traitor and spend the rest of her days in prison - or worse.

episodes.title: Bridge and Tunnel
episodes.summary: In the episode, "Bridge and Tunnel," Howard Stark's deadliest weapon has fallen into enemy hands, and only Agent Carter can recover it. But can she do so before her undercover mission is discovered by SSR Chief Dooley and Agent Thompson?

episodes.title: Time and Tide
episodes.summary: As Agent Carter closes in on Howard Stark's stolen technology, Peggy's secret mission could unravel when the SSR arrests Jarvis and a secret is revealed.

episodes.title: The Blitzkrieg Button
episodes.summary: Peggy may be in more trouble than usual when fugitive Howard Stark suddenly returns for mysterious reasons. And Chief Dooley chases a new clue all the way to Europe that threatens to destroy Peggy's future at the SSR.

episodes.title: The Iron Ceiling
episodes.summary: Peggy is finally trusted with a mission and calls upon her trusted Howling Commandos squad for backup. But her cover could be at risk when SSR Chief Dooley also sends Agent Thompson with her.

episodes.title: A Sin to Err
episodes.summary: Peggy discovers the shocking truth about Leviathan but doesn't realize that her true enemies are even closer than she imagined. Meanwhile, Souza is close to confirming the truth about Peggy and may just put her in the crosshairs of the SSR.

episodes.title: Snafu
episodes.summary: Peggy is cornered and more vulnerable than ever as Leviathan makes their move against her. As the SSR zeroes in on Howard Stark, they may pay the ultimate price as they find their true enemy is closer than they realized.

episodes.title: Valediction
episodes.summary: Peggy faces the full fury of Leviathan, as Howard Stark makes his return in the explosive season finale.

episodes.title: The Lady in the Lake
episodes.summary: After the SSR captures Dottie, Jack sends Peggy to LA to help Daniel... and get Peggy out of his hair. However, she's soon swept up in a new investigation when a woman is found in a block of ice next to a frozen lake.

episodes.title: A View in the Dark
episodes.summary: Peggy continues her investigation of Isodyne, and Jason offers to betray his employers to help her. Meanwhile, the Council shuts down Calvin's zero matter project, and Whitney has an unfortunate accident.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.summary: Peggy continues her investigation into Isodyne, and the trail leads her to the Atlas Club. However, Jack refuses to believe her testimony and continues meeting with Vernon. Meanwhile, Calvin sends his assassin to dispose of Peggy, and Howard meets with a scientific genius.

episodes.title: Smoke & Mirrors
episodes.summary: Peggy captures Calvin's hired killer Rufus and interrogates him. However, before she can act on the information Rufus gives her, Vernon steps in and stops the SSR investigations. In the past, the events that led Peggy and Whitney to their current lives are revealed.

episodes.title: The Atomic Job
episodes.summary: When Peggy learns that Whitney and Calvin plan to steal atomic bombs from Roxxon to recreate the zero matter experiment, she organizes a team to stop the couple and get the bombs first.

episodes.title: Life of the Party
episodes.summary: Due to her injury, Peggy has no choice but to turn to an unexpected ally to get a sample of the zero matter from Whitney. Meanwhile, Whitney takes control of the Council, and Jarvis attends a party.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: Peggy and Jarvis go to rescue Dottie from Whitney, unaware that it's a trap... but not for them. Meanwhile, Vernon warns Daniel that he can cooperate with his superiors... or else.

episodes.title: The Edge of Mystery
episodes.summary: Peggy offers Whitney the uranium rods in return for Jason, only to discover that there's a traitor in their midst. Meanwhile, Jarvis asks Rose to look after Ana, and Daniel is forced to choose between Peggy and the mission success.

episodes.title: A Little Song and Dance
episodes.summary: Jack betrays Daniel and Samberly to Vernon and his conspirators... or does he? Meanwhile, Peggy is forced into an uneasy alliance to rescue Jason, only to discover that her ally isn't necessarily on her side.

episodes.title: Hollywood Ending
episodes.summary: Howard, Jason, and Samberly race against the clock to find a way to reopen the rift and send the Zero Matter back to where it came... and receive help from an unexpected ally in their quest.
